2608.30903.title: MMDS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Dynamic Stance in Social Media Interactions
2608.30903.paper_summary: Dynamic stance classification models how a reply responds to its direct parent message, rather than how a post relates to a fixed topic. Existing work has mainly studied this problem in text-only settings, while social media interactions increasingly rely on images, screenshots, memes, reaction images, and cross-modal references. We introduce MMDS-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for multimodal dynamic stance classification in social media parent-reply interactions. MMDS-Bench contains 3,482 multimodal instances annotated with a seven-label dynamic stance taxonomy, together with an 800-instance diagnostic subset that requires structured reasoning over parent understanding, reply understanding, and stance-relation inference. We further annotate each instance with five challenge factors covering multimodal fusion, parent framing, non-literal expression, interaction reasoning, and label-boundary ambiguity. We evaluate 12 closed-source and open-source multimodal large language models and propose a reference-grounded LLM-judge protocol for assessing reasoning quality. Results show that current MLLMs still struggle with multimodal dynamic stance understanding, especially in cases that require relational inference beyond separate parent and reply comprehension.
2608.30903.paper_summary_zh: 動態立場分類模型描述了回覆如何響應其直接的父消息，而不是帖子如何與固定主題相關。現有的研究主要集中在僅文本的環境中，而社交媒體互動越來越依賴於圖像、截圖、迷因、反應圖像和跨模態參考。我們引入了MMDS-Bench，這是一個針對社交媒體父子回覆互動的多模態動態立場分類的診斷基準。MMDS-Bench包含3,482個多模態實例，這些實例使用七標籤的動態立場分類法進行標註，並附有一個800個實例的診斷子集，該子集需要對父理解、回覆理解和立場關係推理進行結構化推理。我們進一步為每個實例標註了五個挑戰因素，涵蓋多模態融合、父框架、非字面表達、互動推理和標籤邊界模糊性。我們評估了12個封閉源和開放源的多模態大型語言模型，並提出了一個基於參考的LLM-judge協議來評估推理質量。結果顯示，目前的MLLM在多模態動態立場理解方面仍然面臨挑戰，特別是在需要超越單獨父和回覆理解的關係推理的情況下。
